title: Kidnapping
grade_or_penalty: 1st degree; 2nd degree if the victim is released unharmed in a safe place before apprehension
key_points: Unlawfully removing someone a substantial distance or confining them for a substantial period to hold for ransom or as a shield or hostage, to facilitate a crime, to inflict injury or terrorize, or to interfere with a government function.
Enhanced sentences when the victim is under 16 and certain aggravators apply.
